WITH artist_counts AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, COUNT(*) as album_count
  FROM Album
  GROUP BY ArtistId
),
total_albums AS (
  SELECT SUM(album_count) as total
  FROM artist_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ac.ArtistId,
    ac.album_count,
    ac.album_count * 1.0 / ta.total as share
  FROM artist_counts ac
  CROSS JOIN total_albums ta
  WHERE ta.total IS NOT NULL
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM shares
  WHERE share IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  s.ArtistId,
  s.album_count,
  s.share,
  s.share - a.avg_share as difference
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
